subject: Post-call: Dedicated pool resiliency, isolation & procurement asks
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha@novacentral.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-22T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — dedicated pool resiliency and isolation

Hi Samantha —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we keep momentum with procurement and security review. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you mentioned
- Latency spikes and throughput variability during batch inference windows (affects customer SLAs).
- Need for strict tenant isolation for models trained on customer data and for PHI-sensitive workloads.
- Procurement timeline: security review + contract redlines need to complete in ~6–8 weeks.
- Auditability: retention of audit logs for 13 months, encryption-at-rest + in-transit.

Goals you shared
- Dedicated reserved pool that supports sustained 100 QPS for short inference (<=512 tokens) and burst to 350 QPS.
- p99 latency target <=200ms for standard requests; soft targets for heavy batch jobs.
- Formal SLAs and clear billing isolation (separate invoice and usage bucket per product team).

High-level technical alignment
- We recommend a dedicated isolated pool (VPC-backed) with 4x A100-equivalent nodes as your starting commit. That gives predictable throughput and lets us provision prefix caching for common prompts to reduce token cost.
- Isolation: network-level segmentation + customer-specific GKE node pools (or on-prem VM mapping) and separate key management via your KMS.
- Reliability: we propose a 99.95% availability SLA for the reserved pool with automated cross-region fallback as an optional add-on.

Immediate next steps
1) I’ll share a first-pass proposal (SOW + pricing) + architecture diagram — attached.
2) Security questionnaire: Stephanie will own coordination on SOC2/compliance materials.
3) Schedule a 60-min design workshop next week with your infra and security folks to size the canary and confirm isolation details.
4) Procurement: please share a procurement contact and any PO template.

Attachments: redwood-novacentral-dedicated-proposal-v1.pdf, isolation-arch-diagram.png, sample-sla-appendix.docx

Proposed dates for workshop: Tue 9/28 10am PT or Wed 9/29 2pm PT — we can adjust.

Thanks — looking forward to keeping this moving.

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

From: Samantha Cole <samantha@novacentral.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@novacentral.ai>, Novacentral Procurement <procurement@novacentral.ai>
Date: 2026-09-22T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — dedicated pool resiliency and isolation

Thanks Jordan — helpful summary. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- The 100 QPS baseline is for our customer-facing API (low-latency). We also run nightly batch scoring that can peak higher but can tolerate higher latency — ideally isolated from the realtime pool.
- For compliance, SOC2 Type II is mandatory; we also have an in-house checklist your security team will need to complete.
- Procurement note: our Sourcing team needs a commercial proposal with an explicit billing separation option (we need 2 invoices: product team A + product team B).

Procurement timeline:
- Security review (2 weeks internal vetting)
- Contract negotiation (2–4 weeks)
- PO issuance target: by end of November if approvals go smoothly

Also — curious on the pricing direction. Can you provide a rough MRR range on the committed pool (ballpark) so I can flag to our finance owner?

Appreciate the proposed workshop times; Tue 9/28 10am PT works for Alex and me. I’ll loop in our security lead once you confirm.

On Tue, Sep 22, 2026 at 3:04 PM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (see recap and attachments)

Best,
Samantha Cole
Head of AI Platform | Novacentral
Samantha.Cole@novacentral.ai

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha@novacentral.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Novacentral Procurement <procurement@novacentral.ai>
Date: 2026-09-23T09:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — dedicated pool resiliency and isolation

Appreciate the quick reply, Samantha — answering the two asks inline and next steps below.

Pricing ballpark (monthly committed pool) — high-level, we’ll refine in the formal proposal:
- 4x A100-equivalent reserved nodes (sustained 100 QPS + prefix caching): $45k–$65k / month committed (volume discounts apply).
- Option to add burst capacity for heavy batch windows (usage-based during bursts).
- SLA add-on (multi-region fallback + higher availability): additional 10–15% of committed fee.

Isolation approach
- Realtime pool: dedicated VPC + separate billing/usage bucket. Batch processing: recommend a separate reserved group or scheduled burst nodes so batch doesn’t affect realtime p99s.
- KMS: support for your KMS (bring-your-own-key) for model artifacts and logs.
- Audit & retention: default 13 months; we can extend on request.

Security & compliance
- Stephanie will send the SOC2 package and our standard controls matrix by end of day. Can you confirm the email for your security lead?

Next actions
1) I attached the first-pass proposal and an architecture diagram. Please treat numbers as draft — we’ll finalize after the workshop.
2) Karthik will run the design workshop and capture sizing for canary + production.
3) I’ll publish a HubSpot record and send a DocuSign route for the standard MSA + SOW once legal confirms the redlines.

Can we lock Tue 9/28 10am PT for the workshop? If yes, Karthik will send a calendar invite and agenda.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the security package in a separate email.

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0182

Attachments: redwood-novacentral-dedicated-proposal-v1.pdf, sample-sla-appendix.docx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Cole <samantha@novacentral.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>, Novacentral Procurement <procurement@novacentral.ai>
Date: 2026-09-24T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Design workshop invite + pre-work items

Hi Samantha / team —

Thanks for confirming time — workshop is scheduled for Tue 2026-09-28 10:00am PT. Calendar invite with video link sent (calendar:design-workshop-2026-09-28-10am). Agenda (60 min):
- 0–10m: intros + goals
- 10–30m: production traffic profile & failure modes (Jordan to share sample traces)
- 30–45m: isolation patterns & KMS integration plan (Stephanie to cover compliance checklist)
- 45–60m: canary plan & success criteria, next steps for procurement

Pre-work requests (helps us size the canary exactly):
- A representative traffic sample (CSV) with request size distribution and QPS by hour (anonymized).
- List of the top 10 prompt templates and any PHI markers.
- Procurement contact + PO template (if you have one).

I’ll own the sizing and produce a short one-page canary plan after the call. If you want, I can include a cost/throughput sensitivity matrix for different commit sizes.

Looking forward —
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
notes: Thread captures a post-discovery sales cadence focused on reserved dedicated GPU pool, isolation/KMS needs, SLA targets, and procurement coordination. Internal participants are all Redwood sales/solutions leads.
